run_respond: run the respond function to get a model response using a selected prompting method
run_vanilla_prompting: run vanilla_prompting to get a direct model response to a prompt with temperature 0
run_naive_factuality_prompt: run naive_factuality_prompt to get a factually accurate model response to a prompt
run_punt_if_unsure: run punt_if_unsure to get a model response that indicates when it does not know the answer
run_fill_format_with_prompt: run fill_format_with_prompt to substitute a prompt string into a prompt format template
